measurement.order: Fixed registered cases. Rotate arms by case_index+trial and reverse odd trials. Serial timing in each environment. CI shards partition cases only; no pooling machines or Python versions.
measurement.audit: One fresh common call-trace child; retain existing sys.setprofile budgets and execution guards. Never run with tracemalloc.
measurement.memory: One separate fresh tracemalloc child; Python peak, not RSS. No PR47 tracer. Exact canonical delivery/result match.
measurement.timing: Seven fresh children without PR47 tracer/tracemalloc; intrinsic instrumentation retained, instrumented development latency. Include native proof, adapter, all built-in checks and delivery encoding. Cold receiver check, service assess, export/explain and 64 application sequences separately measured.
measurement.cost: Primary lifecycle = build + cold check + all registered consumer assessments + one export/explain per packet. Apply is additional separate scenario. Whole child process overhead shown separately. Failed work included.
measurement.aggregation: All samples, median/min/max. Per family and width and delivery. No universal threshold or population speedup claim; packet size is total independent bytes, no free dedup.

causal_comparisons: new query/no_lemmas versus sdk_default; new query/reuse versus sdk_reuse; new ordinary/reuse versus sdk_direct at sufficient full horizon. New ordinary/no_lemmas has no old matched planner arm. Report four-factor outcomes and native questions; do not infer pure reuse from sdk_direct versus sdk_default.
semantic_population: All 27 signed PR47 cases across all four configurations, plus inactive horizon, native prefix/promotion attacks, input mutations, ordinary bounded gap, byte-identical full-horizon ground adapters and old cold acceptance. Six phase cases retain the old unchanged path in prior regression/CI.
resources: Call budget remains research Python entries, now counts new functions. No free migration to another stage. Equal structural limits; any changed outcome at max_work is separately a resource behavior change, not added semantic coverage.
failure_policy: Every scheduled attempt recorded; no retry inside run. Missing audit still gets an explicit failed checker attempt. Interrupted parent leaves checkpoint and manifest. Unexpected result, timeout, corrupted evidence or identity drift fails engineering acceptance; an economic loss does not.
acceptance: Old independent checker accepts positives, all histories replay with search and positive execution blocked, normal/-O agree; report all lifecycle samples, peaks and preparation counts. Negative economic result accepted. No PR52 win/default/F1 claim.
preservation: All accepted PR47 bytes/modes unchanged except additive research/regression/SUITES.json. New workflow only. Ground algorithm copies have explicit provenance; ground_check/query only use admitted input instead of parse; ordinary adds an explicitly bounded active-node control. Old cold checker unchanged.
boundary: Process-local immutable capabilities only; no Python-reflection sandbox or cross-version transport promise. JSON never carries trust. Native evidence fully checked at insertion; old cold checker fully replays final packets.
